findings.description: Direct V22 sit and crouch views still show fitted shorts and substantial upper-thigh exposure because the front lap panels lift/separate while side and rear skirt panels hang behind the bent legs. Coverage remains unacceptable for the intended skirt.
V22 front, three-quarter, and side renders still show irregular crumpled planar folds and a visibly lumpy side/rear fold mass instead of controlled pleats.
The V22 direct back view still does not make the waist adjustment tab or buckle identifiable; the small protrusion visible obliquely is not legible from the rear.
The current V22 mesh showcase records UV status MISSING. No authored UV layout is available; a topology display does not establish UV mapping.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V22 increases lavender piping and elbow-channel contrast. Direct five-view/six-pose inspection finds the jacket details more legible at render scale, while the skirt still fails sit/crouch coverage and has lumpy folds, the rear tab is unreadable, and authored UVs are missing.

nextAction: REJECT. Keep as unapproved prototype. Replace the skirt panel/attachment and cloth method so a continuous front lap remains over the thighs in sit and crouch; control side/rear folds; make the rear tab and buckle identifiable in the back view; author and verify UVs on the current garment source. Rebuild as a new revision and directly inspect all five views and six poses. Fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime, package, and release remain unverified or blocked.
